items.body:
Thanks for reporting this. The link to `AI_POLICY.md` in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) (line 9) points to the `master` branch, which you report returns a 404. Please describe the link fix in this issue; pull requests are limited to repository collaborators, so a maintainer will decide how to handle it. Contribution steps are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md). Related earlier reports: #4203 and #4029.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
